title: Safe Type Punning & Byte Copying
description:
Reinterpreting raw bytes from a communication buffer or sensor as a multi-byte integer is a classic embedded task.

Casting `*(uint32_t*)byte_ptr` can violate strict aliasing and cause hard-to-debug unaligned memory access faults on ARM Cortex-M0/M3 architectures.

### Safe Solutions:
1. Implement a safe byte-by-byte `my_memcpy(dst, src, n)`.
2. Safely unpack 4 bytes into a 32-bit word using byte copying.
hint: Using `my_memcpy` into a destination array `uint32_t val[1]` allows the compiler to handle alignment safely without violating strict aliasing.
